suite: E2E journeys (real worker + SES stand-in + fake IMAP)

cases.title: Self sign-up creates a workspace; the owner is SUPER_ADMIN of a fresh tenant
Owner builds the hierarchy (owner L1 -> manager L2 -> two agents L3)
Sender identity (company + postal address) saved and read back complete
Two mailboxes connected with IMAP settings; secrets encrypted at rest and never returned
IMAP connection test: the API container really logs in to the (fake) mailbox
Mailbox domain was registered as an SES identity (domain-verification flow reached SES)
CSV validation: 21 rows -> 16 accepted, 5 rejected, each with its specific reason
Confirming the upload creates the list with exactly the 16 accepted contacts
Companies from the CSV exist as accounts (15 distinct names; Ann+Bo share 'Alpha Corp')
All 16 contacts are readable via the contacts API with names/companies from the CSV
Campaign created in DRAFT with both mailboxes, 24h UTC window, sender name/title
3-step sequence saved with wait days 0 / 2 / 3
Wizard 'generate templates' works without an LLM (fallback template per persona)
Fallback step-1 template carries personalisation tokens and no unresolved internal placeholders
Fallback gives a usable 3-step sequence (a template for EVERY step)
Enrolment: 16 enrolled, 0 rejected (wizard step 'launch' part 1)
Enrolling the same list again is idempotent: nobody enrolled twice
Every step already has a template, so no follow-up template has to be added by hand
Launch with the fallback templates (none added by hand) -> ACTIVE
48 messages pre-scheduled (16 contacts x 3 steps), all SCHEDULED, inboxes alternate 8 / 8
Step-1 subject/body are rendered per contact: first name + company substituted, no '{{' left
Pre-scheduling places step 1 on a business day (not weekend) and not before launch
Planned follow-ups are spaced by the configured wait days (step2 >= step1+2d, step3 >= step2+3d)
The worker sends all 16 step-1 emails through SES (captured by the stand-in), none to rejected rows
Exactly one email per eligible contact: no duplicates, count == eligible prospects (16)
DB <-> SES correlation: ses_message_id == SES id, provider_message_id == MIME Message-ID, per recipient
Per-inbox pacing: 8 per inbox, consecutive sends >= ~delay_between_emails (4s, jitter <= 25%)
Daily-limit counters on the mailboxes reflect the sends (8 + 8)
MIME headers: From=mailbox, Reply-To, List-Unsubscribe (URL with message id + mailto), List-Unsubscribe-Post one-click, Message-ID on the sender domain
Body: tenant's postal address exactly once (CAN-SPAM footer), contact first name + company resolved, no placeholders
Signature: single sign-off using the campaign's sender name; footer not followed by a second signature
Every email carries a unique unsubscribe URL built from BASE_URL (/api/tracking/unsubscribe/<message id>)
Unsubscribe_mode 'plain': body explains how to unsubscribe (reply) and the link lives in List-Unsubscribe
Campaign counters after the send: sent_count == 16
Delivery events for 15 messages accepted ('processed'); an immediate replay of each is 'duplicate'
Open (10 contacts) and Click (4 contacts, 5 links) events processed once; replays are 'duplicate'
Hard bounce event processed; replay ignored
Event rows exactly match the posts: 15 delivered, 11 open rows (10 contacts + 1 re-open), 5 click rows, 1 bounce
Message final_status: 15 DELIVERED, 1 BOUNCED (BR-DF-04)
Hard bounce: contact suppressed, enrolment BOUNCED, steps 2+3 not sendable; campaign (1/16) NOT auto-paused
Campaign detail metrics: sent 16, opened 10 (unique contacts), bounced 1
GET /campaigns/{id}/metrics agrees with the campaign detail (opened 10, bounced 1, open rate 10/16)
Analytics step 1: sent 16, opened 10, bounced 1, open rate 62.5, click rate 40.0 (4 of 10 openers)
Dashboard summary (tenant total) matches: 16 sent, 10 opened, 4 clicked, 1 bounced, 16 contacted
Global analytics KPIs equal the dashboard summary
Campaign comparison row agrees (sent 16, opened 10, bounced 1)
Analytics time-series for today: sent 16 / opened 10 / bounced 1
GET on the real unsubscribe link shows a confirmation page and changes nothing (link scanners are safe)
POST (the page's button) unsubscribes: suppression row, consent UNSUBSCRIBED, enrolment UNSUBSCRIBED
RFC 8058 one-click POST ('List-Unsubscribe=One-Click') unsubscribes without a confirmation step
Unsubscribed contact (unsub_link): steps 2 and 3 are CANCELLED, nothing left pending
Unsubscribed contact (unsub_oneclick): steps 2 and 3 are CANCELLED, nothing left pending
Unsubscribe is an event on the original message and counted in the campaign metrics (2)
Re-enrolling an unsubscribed contact is refused with an 'unsubscribed' reason
Uploading the unsubscribed address again is rejected as unsubscribed
Worker sends nothing further to unsubscribed contacts even when their follow-up is forced due (only the step-1 email exists)
Contact timeline records the unsubscribe
IMAP sync ingests the reply: one INBOUND message with the exact body, from the contact to the mailbox
Reply is threaded into the same conversation as the outbound step-1 email (matched by In-Reply-To)
Unified inbox lists the conversation, unread, last message INBOUND
Reply stops that contact's sequence: enrolment REPLIED, steps 2+3 CANCELLED ('contact replied')
Out-of-office auto-reply is stored but does NOT stop the sequence (still ACTIVE, steps 2+3 pending)
Reply 'unsubscribe' suppresses the contact workspace-wide and stops the sequence
Mail from an unknown sender is not turned into a prospect/conversation of this workspace
Reply analytics: 3 reply events (1 genuine, 1 out-of-office, 1 unsubscribe), 1 OOO; campaign counters match
Step-1 analytics and dashboard summary show the same reply numbers
Positive-reply classification for 'looks interesting... pricing for 40 seats'
cases.detail: OPENAI_API_KEY is not set: classify_reply_intent() returns None, so no POSITIVE_REPLY event (0) and /leads/reply-suggestions is 0 item(s). The app has no keyword fallback; the reply is ingested normally.

cases.title: Without an LLM the reply is still ingested and the rest of the chain is unaffected (no POSITIVE event is invented)
Worker's background IMAP loop (no sync API call) logs in and ingests the reply within 10 minutes (BR-DF-05)
Background-ingested reply also stops the sequence (enrolment REPLIED)
Manager turns the reply into a lead owned by agent 1 (one click): ENGAGED, source 'Campaign reply', campaign attached
Second lead for the same open contact is refused (409 with the existing lead id)
Lead visibility follows the hierarchy: owner/manager/agent1 see it, agent2 gets 404
Agent 1 is notified of the assignment ('New lead: <contact>')
Cannot mark SQL before BANT is confirmed (400 lists the missing criteria)
After BANT the agent qualifies the lead: stage SQL with qualified_at set
SQL queue: manager and agent 1 see the lead, agent 2 does not
Convert SQL -> opportunity: amount 24000, close date, owner agent 1, first open stage, attributed to the campaign
Lead becomes CONVERTED linked to the deal; contact lifecycle moves to OPPORTUNITY
Deal moves Qualification -> Needs analysis -> Proposal (amount 30000) -> Negotiation (new close date)
Deal history records stage_id x3, amount and close_date changes with the author's name
Closing as won without a reason is refused (400)
Won with a reason: status WON, closed_at set, reason stored, probability 100
Contact lifecycle is CUSTOMER after the win
Contact history shows lifecycle changes through the funnel (MQL -> SQL -> Opportunity -> Customer)
Deal timeline is available to its owner and not to agent 2
Agent 1 holds the assignment notification created on the way (ASSIGNED 'New lead: Ed Egan')
Notifications for the deal moving to Won / for the manager (stage changes, win)
Pipeline revenue totals = independently computed open amount 55000 / weighted 17400 (+ won excluded)
Forecast by FY quarter (April-March) matches independently bucketed deals incl. boundary dates (Apr 1, Mar 31, Sep 30, Oct 1)
A deal closing 1 April next year lands in the next financial year (5000), not this one
Team performance: agent1 won 1 deal / 30000, 1 lead, 1 SQL, 1 deal created+converted, open pipeline 30000; agent2 lost 1, open 25000
Leaderboard ranks agent 1 first (30000 won) ahead of agent 2 (0)
Sales dashboard KPIs: won 1 / 30000, lost 1, open pipeline 55000, weighted 17400, new leads 1, SQLs 1
Scoping: manager sees the team's numbers (same as owner), agent 2 sees only own (open 25000, won 0)
Amount hiding for AGENT role: deal, list, forecast, dashboard and team scorecard show no amounts; writing one is 403; manager still sees 30000
B01: every live contact's step 2 is scheduled >= step-1 SENT time + 2 days (spacing counts from the real send)
No follow-up is pending for dead contacts (unsubscribed / replied / bounced): 0 SCHEDULED rows
Step 2 goes only to the live contacts (13 minus the held one = 8): none to dead contacts, none to the contact whose step 1 is unsent
Order and spacing: each step 2 was sent after its step 1, and step 3 is re-planned >= step-2 sent + 3 days
Follow-up email content: its own step-2 template ('Following up ...'), contact personalised, footer + unsubscribe header present
Paused campaign: step 3 forced due, yet nothing is sent while PAUSED
Pause answers promptly (< 20 s) while the scheduler is working the campaign
Resume does not burst: overdue step-3 messages are re-spread from now, one per slot per mailbox lane (>= campaign min gap of 120 s apart)
After resume every step-3 email goes out exactly once, spread over time (not a burst)
GDPR erase (DELETE /prospects/{id}) removes the contact and every row keyed by prospect_id
Erased contact: no email events, no messages/conversations with their address remain
Linked lead and deal follow the erasure (gone, or no longer reference the contact)
An audit row records the erasure
Suppression list survives the erasure of another contact (unsubscribed x2 and bounced addresses still blocked)
Two tenants send from the same domain concurrently: 12 + 4 emails delivered to SES, each on its own tenant
4 hard bounces in 12 sends (< 5): campaign stays ACTIVE
A soft (Transient) bounce is recorded but does NOT suppress, fail the message, stop the contact or count towards auto-pause
Domain health row (tenant D): 12 sends in 24h, 4 hard bounces = 33.3% bounce rate, reputation score fell
5th hard bounce auto-pauses the campaign: PAUSED, auto_paused, reason names '5 hard bounces in the first 12 sends'
Tenant E on the SAME domain is unaffected: campaign ACTIVE, own domain row with 4 sends / 0% bounce; D's row shows its own 12 / 41.7%
Suppressions created for D's 5 hard-bounced addresses only (not the soft one), none for tenant E
Alert raised for tenant D (auto-pause) after the deliverability job; tenant E sees none of it
Owner is notified that the campaign was auto-paused (notification centre)
Resuming an auto-paused campaign works (ACTIVE) and a baseline stops the old bounces re-pausing it at once
1 complaint in 10 sends (< 2): contact suppressed + message COMPLAINED, campaign still ACTIVE
2nd complaint auto-pauses ('2 spam complaints in the first 10 sends')
Non-raw SNS envelope ({Message: json}) with the token is accepted and processed
54 sends, 2 hard bounces (3.7% < 5%): still ACTIVE (the '5 bounces' rule no longer applies, the rate does)
3rd hard bounce = 5.6% >= 5% of 54 sends: auto-paused with the rate in the reason
Resume of the rate-paused campaign works; its health is then judged on sends AFTER the resume (baseline), so the old bounces do not re-pause it
A complaint about an email sent BEFORE the resume does not count against the resumed campaign (stays ACTIVE), but the contact is suppressed
Hourly health cycle (send_safety) leaves tenant E's campaign ACTIVE and keeps D's paused campaigns paused
Register: owner is SUPER_ADMIN, ACTIVE, MFA off
MFA enrolment: wrong code rejected (401), correct TOTP enables it and returns 10 one-time recovery codes
After logout, password login does NOT give a session: it asks for the second factor (mfa_token, no access token)
MFA verify: wrong code 401; right TOTP code issues access + refresh tokens usable on /me
Recovery code signs in once; the same code is refused the second time
Invite creates an INVITED user and sends a real email (captured in SES) with a magic link + temporary password; the API response does not leak either
Invitee follows the emailed magic link: status INVITED -> ACTIVE, session issued; the link works once only
Invitee sets their own password using the emailed temporary one; new password logs in, temporary no longer does
Invitee lands in the inviter's tenant with the invited role
Forgot-password: real email with a reset link is captured; unknown address gets the same generic 200 and no email
Reset: new password works, old password rejected, link is single-use, refresh token issued before the reset is revoked
Role change takes effect immediately on the user's existing token (AGENT cannot list users, ADMIN can)
Deactivation is immediate: the user's still-unexpired access token is rejected, login refused
Reactivation restores sign-in
Changing the password revokes outstanding refresh tokens
Suspended tenant: sign-in refused (403 'Tenant suspended') and already-issued tokens stop working; reactivation restores access
MFA can be turned off with password + code; login then returns a session directly
Same 6 recipients, same domain, two tenants launched together: each recipient gets exactly 2 emails (one per tenant), each from its own mailbox
Each tenant's emails carry its own identity: distinct unsubscribe URLs (12), tenant Y's footer address is Y's, X's is X's
SES events for X's messages move only X's numbers (X opened 3 / Y opened 0), Y's metrics untouched
X's recipient unsubscribes: suppressed in X only; Y still has them subscribed with step 2 pending
Reply lands in X only: X's conversation with that address ends INBOUND (REPLIED), Y's own conversation with the same address stays OUTBOUND-only, enrolment ACTIVE, step 2 pending
Bounce on Y's message: Y suppresses r2 and Y's domain health shows it; X's suppression and domain row are clean
Step 2 goes to exactly each tenant's own live contacts: X skips its unsubscribed+replied (4 sent), Y skips its bounced (5 sent)
Independent daily limits: X's mailbox is capped at 10/day so its step 3 is held, while Y (same domain) sends all 5
Cross-tenant object access by id is refused (404) for read, write, pause and erase
Global search for the shared address domain returns each tenant only its own records (no foreign ids)
Contact exports contain only the caller's tenant (6 data rows each, no cross ids, own sender-specific data)
Reports: each tenant's total_emails_sent equals its own OUTBOUND sends (X 10, Y 16 incl. the bounced one); inbound replies/bounce notices are not 'sent'
Domain health is per tenant: after the health cycle each has one row for the shared domain with its own 24h counters (X 10 sends / 0% bounce; Y 16 sends / bounce > 0)
Import preview: 12 rows detected and columns auto-mapped (email, name, company, domain, title)
Import: 10 contacts + 2 companies created, 2 rejected rows with reasons (invalid email, in-file duplicate)
Mapped custom field created (NUMBER) and populated (w2 -> 3); contacts linked to the company by domain; tags split
Static list holds the 6 Wayne contacts; active list (tag imp-<run>) resolves to all 10 from its filter
Bulk edit: tag added to 4 contacts, 2 reassigned to the agent; history shows both changes; active list still resolves 10
Duplicate detection lists the two 'Dee Dupe' contacts as one group
Merge: duplicate's lead, deal, task, activity, list membership and campaign enrolment are re-pointed to the surviving contact; chosen field (CTO) wins
After merge the campaign has exactly one pending email, addressed to the surviving contact (no double send, none to the merged address)
Merged duplicate no longer exists (404, row removed - the survivor keeps the data)
Soft delete: contact hidden (404), appears in the recycle bin with purge date + who deleted; active list drops it (9), nothing else removed
Restore brings the contact back with its lead, task and list memberships; active list returns to 10
After 90 days restore is refused and the purge job removes the contact with its lead, task, list memberships and history; an audit row remains
Purge touched nothing else: 9 imported contacts + the company still exist
Two campaign automation rules created (open -> pause prospect, click -> send template)
SES Open event fires the 'pause prospect' rule: enrolment becomes PAUSED
SES Click event fires the 'send email' rule: the worker sends the rule's template to that contact through SES (personalised subject)
A PAUSED prospect receives no further sequence step (step 2 goes only to the other 3 contacts)
Workflow rules created (lead->SQL: task + notify manager; deal amount > 20000: set COMMIT + notify)
Lead -> SQL runs the rule: owner gets a task 'Prepare handover for Wf0 Lead' due in 2 days
Manager is notified ('Wf0 Lead reached SQL'); rule run_count = 1; a non-matching change (SQL -> same) does not re-run it
Deal amount raised 15000 -> 25000 crosses the threshold: forecast category set to COMMIT by the rule and manager notified once
Raising it further (25000 -> 30000, already above) does not fire the rule again
Round-robin assignment: 6 unowned contacts -> leads cycle through the 3-agent pool in order (a1,a2,a3,a1,a2,a3) and the agents are notified
Assigned agent gets an 'ASSIGNED' notification per lead (agent 2 received 2)
Stale-deal job: idle 20 days -> owner alerted ('no activity for 20 days'); past close date -> alerted; fresh deal -> nothing
Running the job again does not duplicate the alert (one per deal per week)
Notification e-mail delivery: the stale-deal alert is emailed to the owner through SES ('[Vector] Stale deal: ...' with a link)
A user who switched e-mail notifications off still gets the in-app alert but no e-mail (agent 3: alert yes, mail none; agent 2 mailed)
Lead recycle: a disqualified lead whose recycle date has passed returns to NEW, owner notified ('Lead back in play'), recycle date cleared
Marking notifications read clears the unread counter
